_meta.purpose: Truth layer for quarter-turn valve assemblies. The valve sizing engine references THIS file for all torque data, actuator outputs, severe-service factors, and stock pairings — it never holds valve logic in code. Same anti-hallucination discipline as axg_model_code.json / vy_model_code.json.
_meta.source: Allied stock list (South Digital, 80 psi air) + actuator torque charts + valve torque tables, provided 2026-06-22.
_meta.status: FIELD-PROVEN BUILDS are the primary authority (verified at 2 locations: South Digital + Loudon TN; actuator sizing identical at both). Torque chart is a SECONDARY backstop for severe-service / off-list sizing only.
_meta.air_pressure_basis: 80 psi instrument air (actuator outputs are at 80 psi).
_meta.authority_model: Field-proven stock builds = primary truth (these run daily without field issues). Torque math = secondary, used ONLY for severe service (slurry/ESD/low-temp) or sizes/families not in the stock builds.
_meta.package_types: TWO package types: 'digital' (on/off, solenoid-stroked) and 'control' (modulating, positioner-controlled). Same valve+linkage; control element and (for FLOW-TEK) actuator differ. WKM actuator is the SAME for both types; FLOW-TEK control actuators are UPSIZED vs digital (modulating needs more torque).
_meta.air_pressure_dimension: Air pressure (80 vs 60 psi) is a REQUIRED sizing dimension. Lower air pressure UPSIZES the actuator (same actuator makes less torque at lower air, so a bigger one is needed for the same valve). Actuator suffix encodes it: SR80 vs SR60. 80psi=South Digital/Loudon, 60psi=Decatur IL.
_meta.matrix_completeness: COMPLETE for standard service: 2 families x 2 package types (digital/control) x 2 air pressures (80/60) x locations (South Digital, Loudon, Decatur). All actuators field-proven. Control element positioner varies by location (EP5N / D3XNU).

assembly_skeleton._note: A quarter-turn valve package is a multi-component ASSEMBLY (Section 15 result shape), not a single code. Components:

components.varies_by: computed from valve torque + severe service

constant_trim._note: Identical on EVERY standard assembly — house-standard, like AXG override-only defaults.

m15_valve_torque_raw_in_lb._note: M15 valve break torque, RAW — 'No safety factor applied'. A base safety factor MUST be applied before sizing (factor PENDING). Then severe-service multipliers stack on top.

actuator_output_in_lb._note: Governing minimum torque output ('Min.' column) at 80 psi air. Pick smallest actuator whose output >= required. Includes ISO mounting pattern and star (stem) size.
actuator_output_in_lb._other_brands_available: Unitork K, Elomatic FS, Rotork GT, Max-Air MT, ABZ output tables also provided — can be added as alternate-brand selection. Hytork XL is the stock-list brand.
actuator_output_in_lb._missing: XL26 and XL71 (used on small FLOW-TEK valves in stock list) are NOT in the torque chart — cannot torque-size those; stock lookup only until their outputs are provided.

maxair_mast_limits_Nm._note: Max Allowable Shaft Torque (MAST) by size/class, for 17-4PH(A564 630)-H1100. Upper bound — actuator output must not exceed valve shaft limit.

sizing_logic.standard_basis: Size to 100 psig shutoff (standard packages). Shutoff overridable per-application — higher differential reads a higher torque row.
sizing_logic.rule: required_output = valve_torque(size, shutoff) [x base_factor if RAW family] x severe_service_factor. Then pick smallest actuator with output >= required_output. Verify against MAST shaft limit. Show computed pick AND stock pairing; flag if they differ or if stock is under chart.
sizing_logic.WKM: torque chart is PRE-FACTORED — apply NO base factor; severe multiplier stacks on top.
sizing_logic.raw_families_M15_FLOWTEK: apply base_factor FIRST (PENDING), then severe multiplier.

severe_service_factors._note: ADDITIONAL multipliers applied ON TOP of the (already-base-factored for WKM) torque chart value. Confirmed 2026-06-22.
severe_service_factors.stacking_rule: PENDING — when MULTIPLE severe conditions apply (e.g. low-temp + ESD), do factors MULTIPLY (1.20x1.60=1.92) or take the HIGHEST single (1.60)? DO NOT ASSUME — engine must hold this until confirmed.
severe_service_factors._role: SECONDARY backstop. Field-proven core builds are for STANDARD service. Use these factors + torque chart ONLY when service is severe (slurry/ESD/low-temp) or the size/family isn't in the field-proven core. Then flag for human confirmation - do not auto-override the stock build.

pending_confirmations.7_air_pressure_CONFIRMED: CONFIRMED: air pressure (80 vs 60 psi) upsizes the actuator. Captured as a sizing dimension. 80psi=SD/Loudon, 60psi=Decatur. Decatur 60psi digital now loaded.

pending_confirmations.9_lugged_resolved: RESOLVED: user confirmed B5123 lugged / B5120 wafer interchangeable across all accessories+actuators. Lugged is field-proven by equivalence; only the valve body code differs. No separate lugged build list needed.

field_proven_core._note: Valve + linkage shared across package types. ACTUATOR is package-type-dependent: WKM same for digital & control; FLOW-TEK control actuators UPSIZED vs digital. Verified: South Digital + Loudon (digital), control package (this list).

actuator_by_package._note: Actuator depends on: family x package type x AIR PRESSURE x size. Lower air pressure upsizes. CRITICAL: pick by air pressure - a 60psi site needs a bigger actuator than 80psi for the same valve.

field_proven_core.flowtek_control_note: FLOW-TEK control valves use V-PORT trim (modulating). Control adds an 8" size (XL1372) not in the digital list. Linkage for control 1/2": LKO-05-F15-F07 (vs digital LKO-05-F15-F05).

air_pressure_special_cases._note: 60 psi pushes some builds into heavier hardware:
air_pressure_special_cases.WKM_12in_60psi: Actuator XL2586SR6BTS (special SR6BTS suffix, not plain SR60) with linkage LKO-12-B5120-F16BS (BS = heavier). The jump from XL1372(80psi) to XL2586(60psi) is two sizes.
air_pressure_special_cases.WKM_8in_60psi_linkage: 8" 60psi shows linkage LKO-10-B5120-F12 (upsized linkage vs 80psi LKO-8-B5120-F10) - heavier actuator needs the bigger linkage/mount.
air_pressure_special_cases.FLOWTEK_6in_60psi: Mounting VA21754-CTI (note: possibly a typo for VA21724-CTI in source) - large mount for the upsized XL1127.

field_proven_core._upsizing_composition: Two independent upsizing effects STACK: (1) FLOW-TEK control vs digital, (2) lower air pressure (60 vs 80). A small FLOW-TEK control valve at 60psi gets both bumps. WKM actuator is unaffected by package type at either air pressure (air pressure governs WKM).

trim_packages._note: Location-specific trim layered on the core. A quote selects a package -> sets mounting kit, limit switch, and assembly-number suffix. Adding a location = adding one package here, not new builds.
trim_packages._control_note: Control packages in this list use HY-STOOL-SS mounting (to 8") / LARGE HY-STOOL-SS (10-12"), limit handled via positioner feedback. Mounting echoes Loudon-style HY-STOOL.

decatur_il.assembly_suffix_style: ...LOS6TVFDXTK (S6 encodes 60psi air; TVFD the TVF switch)
decatur_il._note: Decatur uses South-Digital-style trim (TVF switch, AV-TA01 mount) but runs 60psi air -> upsized actuators. Trim and air pressure are independent dimensions.

verified_assembly_numbers._note: Exact rolled-up assembly numbers from the stock lists — use these directly, do not generate. Some sizes blank in source.

control_WKM._note: EP/EPT/EPR suffixes encode the EP5N positioner (vs TVFD/NXL for digital limit switches). Several inconsistent; use directly, don't generate.

decatur_60psi_WKM._note: 'S6' in the suffix encodes 60psi air (vs 'SR'/'LOSR' at 80psi). TVFD = TVF limit switch (Decatur uses South-Digital-style TVF trim + AV-TA01 mounting).

decatur_60psi_control_WKM._note: 'S6' encodes 60psi, 'D3' encodes the D3XNU positioner (vs EP for EP5N, TVFD/NXL for digital limit switches). Inconsistent; use directly.

verified_assembly_numbers._flowtek_gaps: Loudon FLOW-TEK and all CONTROL FLOW-TEK assembly numbers were blank in the provided lists - those show to-be-assigned until captured.

control_element_by_package._note: The control element defines the package type. Digital=solenoid+cordset (strokes open/closed). Control=positioner+tubing (modulates).

control.positioner: SEE _positioner_by_location (varies: EP5N default, D3XNU at Decatur)

_positioner_by_location._note: The control positioner model varies by location. EP5N at South Digital / Loudon / etc; D3XNU at Decatur.

body_style._note: Valve body style is a real physical dimension (like flanged vs wafer mag meters). Wafer = sandwiched between two flanges. Lugged = tapped/threaded lugs on each side, bolts to each flange independently, supports dead-end service.

FLOW_TEK_F15.note: F15/RF15-316 are flanged ball valves - one style.

port_by_package.control: V-PORT (V-notch ball, modulating characteristic) — REQUIRED for control. A standard on/off ball cannot modulate. Confirmed: control lists show FLOW-TEK valves as (V PORT); digital lists do not.

wafer.status: FIELD-PROVEN - all loaded WKM builds are B5120 wafer.

lugged.status: FIELD-PROVEN BY EQUIVALENCE (user-confirmed 2026-06-22): B5123 lugged and B5120 wafer are interchangeable across ALL accessories and actuators - only the valve body code differs (B5120<->B5123). Every verified wafer build is therefore also valid as a lugged build with the body swapped. Linkage, actuator, mounting, trim, control element all identical.

WKM_butterfly._interchangeability: CONFIRMED: WKM B5120 (wafer) and B5123 (lugged) share all accessories and actuators. Body style changes ONLY the valve body code; the rest of the assembly is identical for a given size/package/air-pressure/location. So both body styles draw on the same field-proven core.
WKM_butterfly._control_note: Butterfly is inherently throttling-capable; WKM control uses the same B5120/B5123 body as digital, just adds the positioner. No separate control body (unlike FLOW-TEK ball, which needs V-port).

body_style.default_rule: Default to LUGGED (B5123) if body style not stated, but FLAG it (so the user can switch to wafer B5120). Both styles are field-proven by equivalence - same assembly, only the valve body code differs. No caveat needed beyond the standard flag.
body_style.engine_rule: WKM assembly: pull the field-proven build for size/package/air/location, then set valve body = 'WKM B5123' (lugged, default) or 'WKM B5120' (wafer, if stated). All other components (linkage, actuator, mounting, trim, control element) come from the verified build unchanged.

quote_defaults._note: Defaults for unstated dimensions in a loose/partial valve request. Each is assume-and-flag, like AXG -C / EJA /FU1 fail-safe defaults.

air_pressure.rule: Assume 80 psi if not stated, but FLAG. 60psi = Decatur.

package_type.rule: Assume digital (on/off) unless CONTROL is explicitly stated.

body_style.rule: Assume lugged if not stated, but FLAG (see body_style caveat - lugged not yet field-proven on file).

actuator_brand.rule: All field-proven builds use Hytork XL. Default Hytork.

lockout.rule: Lockable linkage kit (LKO-*) is in every field-proven build. Default included.
